intro.title: Build SMS provider failover wrapper
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a failover wrapper for SMS providers, which automatically switches to a backup service if the primary one fails. You'll learn to implement a simple retry and fallback mechanism using asynchronous functions and error handling. The main technologies involved are Node.js, JavaScript Promises, and the concept of service abstraction. This project will help you understand how to create resilient applications that handle external API failures gracefully.
intro.usecase: In production systems, SMS failover wrappers are critical for ensuring reliable communication channels when sending alerts, notifications, or authentication codes. For example, e-commerce platforms use them to send order confirmations and shipping updates, automatically switching providers if the primary service experiences downtime. Financial apps rely on this pattern for transaction alerts and security codes, maintaining service continuity even during provider outages. Customer support dashboards implement similar wrappers to guarantee delivery of appointment reminders and service notifications across multiple SMS gateways.
